tools.name: gaip_diagnose_integration_failure
tools.description: Use this when an agent, MCP or API call failed ("why did my call fail?", "what does this 429 mean?"). Pass the `failure` ({code, detail}) or the raw error text. Returns the likely cause, when and how to retry, fix steps and a receipt. GAIP touches no other system. Free, no account; records a GAIP re

tools.name: gaip_supplier_reliability
tools.description: Use this when a supplier agent or API you depend on started failing ("did something change on their side?"). Pass its `supplier_url` and the `failure`. Returns the diagnosis plus changes GAIP observed around then (correlated in time, not causation), with receipts. Free, read-only, no account; inputs
